publication.titleZh: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 评测：low/max 思考、SVG 与鹈鹕动图
publication.titleEn: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 review: low/max thinking, SVG and cycling animation
publication.summaryZh: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 实测：对比关闭、默认、low 与 max 思考的 SVG 成图和鹈鹕骑车动画，保留失败与重试耗时，附原始代码、36 次文本/代码测试及官方基准原图。
publication.summaryEn: Compare DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 thinking off/default/low/max: SVG outputs, cycling-pelican animations, retry evidence, 36 text/code attempts and official benchmarks.

descriptionZh: DeepSeek 默认开启 thinking，默认档 high；本轮显式增加 low 和 max。温度 0 在思考模式下不生效。原始默认与关闭档来自 10 月 20 日，补测及重试来自 10 月 21 日。deepseek-flash 仍是可变别名，不能证明固定权重。
descriptionEn: DeepSeek defaults to thinking on at high effort; low and max are explicit supplemental settings. Temperature 0 is ignored in thinking mode. Default/off originals are from October 20; supplemental runs are from October 21. deepseek-flash remains a mutable alias, not a pinned checkpoint.

trials.title: 9:41 模拟钟表
trials.prompt: Return only a complete, self-contained static SVG with viewBox="0 0 800 600". Draw a clear analog clock showing exactly 9:41, with all twelve numbers 1 through 12. The hour hand must be correctly positioned between 9 and 10, not exactly on 9. The minute hand must indicate minute 41. Use a shorter hour hand and a longer minute hand, no second hand. Add a small label "09:41" below the dial. Do not use scripts, external assets or embedded images.
rubricZh: 12 个数字完整、顺序正确
分针指向第 41 分钟（从 12 点顺时针 246°）
时针指向 9 点后 41 分钟（290.5°），且短于分针
rubricEn: Twelve numbers in the correct order
Minute hand at 246 degrees clockwise from 12
Shorter hour hand at 290.5 degrees, between 9 and 10
trials.text:
Here is a self-contained SVG of an analog clock set to exactly 9:41, with all twelve numbers and a small “09:41” label below the dial.
```svg
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 600" width="800" height="600">
  <!-- Background -->
  <rect width="800" height="600" fill="#f5f5f0"/>

  <circle cx="400" cy="280" r="220" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="6"/>

  <circle cx="400" cy="280" r="210" fill="none" stroke="#cccccc" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- 4 -->

  <!-- 5 -->
  <line x1="505" y1="475" x2="492" y2="453" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="3"/>
  <!-- 6 -->
  <line x1="400" y1="490" x2="400" y2="465" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="4"/>
  <!-- 7 -->
  <line x1="295" y1="475" x2="308" y2="453" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="3"/>
  <!-- 8 -->
  <line x1="210" y1="410" x2="230" y2="395" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="3"/>
  <!-- 9 -->
  <line x1="190" y1="280" x2="215" y2="280" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="4"/>
  <!-- 10 -->
  <line x1="210" y1="150" x2="230" y2="165" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="3"/>
  <!-- 11 -->
  <line x1="295" y1="85" x2="308" y2="107" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="3"/>

  <!-- Numbers -->
  <text x="400" y="115" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-size="32" font-weight="bold" fill="#333333">12</text>
  <text x="510" y="130" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-size="32" font-weight="bold" fill="#333333">1</text>
  <text x="590" y="200" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-size="32" font-weight="bold" fill="#333333">2</text>
  <text x="620" y="290" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-size="32" font-weight="bold" fill="#333333">3</text>
  <text x="590" y="380" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-size="32" font-weight="bold" fill="#333333">4</text>
  <text x="510" y="450" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-size="32" font-weight="bold" fill="#333333">5</text>
  <text x="400" y="475" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-size="32" font-weight="bold" fill="#333333">6</text>
  <text x="290" y="450" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-size="32" font-weight="bold" fill="#333333">7</text>
  <text x="210" y="380" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-size="32" font-weight="bold" fill="#333333">8</text>
  <text x="180" y="290" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-size="32" font-weight="bold" fill="#333333">9</text>
  <text x="210" y="200" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-size="32" font-weight="bold" fill="#333333">10</text>
  <text x="290" y="130" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-size="32" font-weight="bold" fill="#333333">11</text>

  <!-- Minute hand (pointing at 41 minutes) -->
  <!-- 41 minutes = 41 * 6 = 246 degrees from 12 o'clock -->
  <!-- Angle from positive x-axis: 246 - 90 = 156 degrees -->
  <!-- Length: 160 -->
  <!-- End point: x = 400 + 160*cos(156°), y = 280 + 160*sin(156°) -->
  <!-- cos(156°) ≈ -0.9135, sin(156°) ≈ 0.4067 -->
  <!-- x ≈ 400 - 146.2 = 253.8, y ≈ 280 + 65.1 = 345.1 -->

  <!-- Hour hand (between 9 and 10, at 9:41) -->
  <!-- Hour angle: 9 hours + 41/60 hours = 9.6833 hours -->
  <!-- 9.6833 * 30 = 290.5 degrees from 12 o'clock -->
  <!-- Angle from positive x-axis: 290.5 - 90 = 200.5 degrees -->
  <!-- Length: 100 -->
  <!-- End point: x = 400 + 100*cos(200.5°), y = 280 + 100*sin(200.5°) -->
  <!-- cos(200.5°) ≈ -0.9367, sin(200.5°) ≈ -0.3502 -->
  <!-- x ≈ 400 - 93.7 = 306.3, y ≈ 280 - 35.0 = 245.0 -->
  <line x1="400" y1="280" x2="306" y2="245" stroke="#222222" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Center dot -->
  <circle cx="400" cy="280" r="8" fill="#222222"/>
  <circle cx="400" cy="280" r="4" fill="#cc3333"/>

  <!-- Label "09:41" below the dial -->
  <text x="400" y="545" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-size="28" font-weight="bold" fill="#333333">09:41</text>
</svg>
```
The clock uses a clean white face with dark markers and numerals, plus a short hour hand positioned between 9 and 10 and a longer minute hand pointing to minute 41. The centered label beneath the dial matches the requested time, and the design stays simple and readable.

Draw a recognizable pelican riding a bicycle: long bill and throat pouch, two wheels, connected frame, saddle and handlebar. Animate rotating wheel spokes and a rotating crank with pedaling legs that remain attached to the rider and pedals. Use SVG SMIL animateTransform/animate/animateMotion only (no CSS animation), with a seamless 4-second repeating loop. Keep the whole bicycle and bird on the canvas. Use a light background. No scripts, foreignObject, external assets, external fonts or embedded images. Use only local SVG shapes and text. The animation must visibly move, not just contain animation tags.
